items.excerpt: In this episode, we’ll learn how sellers grow million-dollar businesses, use AI to save time, prepare for retail, and lift profits with practical strategies shared live from the floor of Amazon Accelerate.

Recorded live on the floor of Amazon Accelerate, this episode of the Serious Sellers Podcast brings together seven sellers with different backgrounds, business models, and lessons to share. Bradley Sutton starts with Sky Balukonis, who grew a disposable napkin business from roughly $40,000-$50,000 in first-year sales to a projected $1.4 million annually. Sky explains how disciplined reinvestment, careful cash flow management, and premium positioning helped an everyday product stand out. Danial Khosravi and Nick Karafilov share how they use Claude connected to Helium 10 through MCP to research keywords, improve listing copy, and prepare a data-backed presentation for a Walmart buyer. They also explain how advice from a Helium 10 Elite call with Bradley pushed them to build their Walmart presence, prepare retail-ready packaging, and generate TikTok content. Those efforts helped put them in front of a buyer, with a potential retail agreement still pending at the time of recording.
